complex_logic: Server side request security primitives combining an overlap weighted sliding window request budget, lazy pruning of stale counters, spoof resistant client identification from platform written headers, and a body cap enforced on bytes actually received with early stream cancellation.

Exact monetary arithmetic on integer cents with bounds checks, strict decimal parsing, locale aware grouping done from digits rather than a floating point value, signed basis point returns measured against an absolute base, and rounding symmetric for negative amounts.

Payment confirmation that verifies a signed event against the raw body within a replay tolerance, accepts only paid completed sessions, records each event identity once before notifying, and answers with a failure during storage outages so the processor retries.

Lead intake rules that validate every field, derive a stable notification deduplication key from the submission content and the day, escape markup and strip newlines from subject lines, and keep storage success separate from delivery success.

The static site ships its own dependency free server that serves only an allowlist of browser facing files while blocking traversal, dotfiles and data directories, gates operator listings behind a bearer token, and stores only digests of expiring session tokens.

The multilingual static site has a build gate that cross checks every translation key used in markup against each shipped dictionary, reports unused keys, verifies that every referenced class is styled, and catches duplicate identifiers and missing assets.
substantial_features: Lead capture built over many commits: multilingual forms, a chat widget and a voice callback panel feed one validated intake path that persists the submission, notifies the owner once, and reports stored but undelivered submissions distinctly.

Paid access was built over several commits as a server held catalogue priced in integer cents, a posted checkout initiation redirecting only to a validated origin, and a signed confirmation recording each payment once.

Shared request defence was introduced and then adopted by every public endpoint over several commits, giving each route its own request budget, body cap, validated payload shape and uniform uncacheable error replies.

Owner only administration developed across commits: a single owner identity predicate, a refusal of any other account creation at the authentication layer, session gated aggregate reporting, a polling control room, and unindexable administrative and sign in pages.

The multilingual sales assistant has a bounded conversation schema, an enforced language code, persona rules that forbid inventing listings, keyword detection of buying intent across two scripts that alerts the owner idempotently, and localised replies when the model fails.

Visitor analytics spanning ingestion and reporting: one shared event vocabulary, a validated beacon endpoint, and owner only aggregates covering distinct sessions, a trailing day, funnel stages and traffic source shares, with a test keeping both halves in step.

The public site was reimplemented a second time as plain pages with six language dictionaries, its own dependency free server and data store, a consistency gate, an endpoint test harness and a release bundler.
defect_repairs: Money arithmetic repaired where large amounts lost digits because grouping passed through a floating point value, separators ignored the locale, a recovering negative position reported a loss, scaling rounded asymmetrically for negatives, and positive infinity clamped downward.

The request budget could be spent twice by straddling a window edge and could be evaded by rotating a caller supplied forwarding header; it was replaced with an overlap weighted trailing window keyed on headers the platform writes.

Body size limits were checked only against the declared length, so a chunked request that omitted it was unbounded; the cap is now applied to the bytes actually read and the stream is cancelled the moment it is crossed.

The static site server handed out every file in the project folder, including its database, its user store and its own source; serving became an allowlist by file type and location with dotfile and traversal guards.

Lead intake answered a client error for a storage outage and told visitors their submission failed when only the notification failed, inviting duplicates; storage and delivery outcomes were separated and retries deduplicated by a content derived key.

Lead forms collected a phone number, budget, message and language that storage silently dropped; the columns were added idempotently and the code tolerates running ahead of that change by detecting the missing column through wrapped database errors.

The media proxy hung when the origin stopped answering, let shared caches store partial responses without varying on the requested range, and flattened an unsatisfiable range into a generic failure; all three were fixed together.

Reports counted visitor event names that the ingestion endpoint rejected, so some funnel stages could never rise above zero; the vocabulary became shared and a test now fails whenever the two drift apart.

Session tokens in that same server were stored in clear, never expired and were compared byte by byte, while sign in skipped hashing for unknown addresses; tokens now rotate, expire, are kept only as digests and compare in constant time.
work_units: Replace the per instance request budget with one shared across instances, keeping the trailing window semantics and the retry delay contract while tolerating restarts and concurrent increments.
Implement exactly once payment recording: verify the signature, survive concurrent redeliveries of the same event, and make recording and notifying succeed or fail together.

Build the money module from a specification: integer cents, exact decimal parsing, locale correct formatting without precision loss, signed returns in basis points, and rounding half away from zero, proven by round trip tests.

Build a byte range media proxy with provable cache behaviour: forward ranges, bound how long the origin may take, propagate client disconnects, and ensure no shared cache can serve one visitor the range another asked for.

Harden a file server so it serves only browser facing assets: allowlist by type and location, defeat encoded traversal and dotfiles, support extensionless routes, and prove sensitive paths are unreachable.

Make a schema addition safe in either deploy order: store the new optional fields when they exist, fall back to the core fields when they do not, and detect that condition from a wrapped database error rather than a flag.

Write a build gate for a multilingual static site that fails when markup, dictionaries, stylesheet and assets drift apart, naming every missing key, unstyled class, duplicate identifier and absent file.

Build an idempotent outbound notification path: derive stable deduplication keys from message content and a time bucket, separate persistence success from delivery success in the reply, and make retries safe.
net_new_capabilities: Build a verified listing catalogue with its own data model, intake and verification workflow, media handling, and search by location, price band and asset type, replacing the hard coded showcase the pages render today.

An investment modelling engine on top of the exact cent arithmetic that computes yield, financing cost, holding period, fees and market specific tax treatment into comparable projected returns with an auditable breakdown.

Build a viewing and test drive scheduling subsystem with per asset and per agent availability, time zone correct slot generation, holds, confirmations, reminders and cancellation rules, which the assistant already promises but nothing implements.

Build a lead lifecycle pipeline that scores submissions from form and conversation signals, moves them through stages with ownership and follow up queues, and reports outcomes, replacing the single notification email.

Multiple brokerage accounts with roles and scoped permissions in place of the single owner model, including per tenant data isolation, invitations, scoped reporting and an audit trail of privileged actions.

Grounded answering for the sales assistant so replies may cite only records in the verified catalogue, with freshness guarantees and an explicit refusal when nothing matches, enforcing what the persona instructions only request.

Durable conversation storage for the assistants with transcript retrieval, continuity between the text widget, the voice session and messaging channels, and per conversation consent and retention rules.

Extend payments beyond one off purchases: recurring plans, renewals, proration, refunds, failed payment recovery, dispute handling, and a reconciliation report matching recorded payments against the processor ledger.

Market data collection and history: scheduled gathering from providers, normalisation across differing shapes and currencies, stored time series, and trend signals computed from that history rather than taken from a provider field.
Server rendered multilingual delivery with a distinct address and translated metadata per language and a translation workflow, replacing client side dictionary swapping driven by a query parameter.
Replace fire and forget notification with a durable outbound queue: queued attempts with backoff, dead lettering, and operator visibility into what was actually delivered.

Privacy request tooling to back the stated commitments: export, correction and erasure of a person across leads, visit records and conversations, with retention schedules and evidence that each request completed.
repo_evolutions: The product exists twice over: a generated application was committed with nested duplicate package roots and archived copies of itself, then an independently built plain page rewrite of the same marketing and lead surface was added beside it.

Logic that lived inline in request handlers was pulled out into framework free and database free modules for validation, request defence, media proxying, payment verification and the event vocabulary, so behaviour could be exercised under a plain test runner.

Request budgeting was redesigned from a fixed window refreshed by a background timer into an overlap weighted trailing window pruned on demand, which also removed side effects that ran merely by importing the module.

The market price endpoint changed from returning fixed demonstration figures to adapting a configured provider feed, turning a call that always succeeded into one with distinct unavailable, provider error, timeout and unsupported shape outcomes.
Schema change management arrived: changes now ship as ordered idempotent statements with instructions, and the application was reshaped to keep working when it runs ahead of them.
performance_work: Market prices moved from calling the provider on every visit to a shared cached answer with a one minute freshness window and a five minute window in which a stale answer may be served while refreshing.

Asset caching was corrected from a year long immutable policy on filenames that carry no content fingerprint to a short window with background revalidation, so a deploy is not pinned in browsers for a year.
The request counter store gained threshold triggered pruning of counters older than two windows in place of a periodic timer, bounding memory while removing work done at import time.
Reporting aggregates are issued as one concurrent batch rather than in sequence, covering distinct session counts, a trailing day, funnel stages and a grouped traffic source breakdown.
hardening_work: Every public endpoint gained a scoped request budget, a body cap measured on received bytes, a validated payload shape, uniform uncacheable error replies, and logging that records a message without leaking internals.
Account creation now refuses anyone but the owner at the authentication layer, and the owner identity was reduced to a single predicate that every privileged check shares.
Aggregate business reporting was placed behind the owner session like the administrative report, while administrative and sign in pages became unindexable and stopped prefilling the owner address.

In the static server, listing personal data now requires an operator token, the inbound hook requires a shared secret and refuses when none is configured, buyer addresses left session lookups, and event batches are capped.

Response headers gained frame denial, a policy restricting framing ancestors and form targets, transport security extended to subdomains, and a microphone permission limited to this origin for the voice session.
Owner notifications became idempotent through content derived keys, with escaped message bodies and subject lines stripped of newlines so a name cannot inject extra mail headers.
The checkout redirect target is taken from a validated configured origin that refuses plain transport outside development, closing a path that could have sent buyers somewhere else.
integration_work: Payment processor integration: hosted session creation with server held prices in integer cents, and a confirmation endpoint that reads the raw body under a cap, verifies the signature within a replay window and filters by event type and payment state.

The market data adapter accepts three different envelope shapes, coerces loosely typed fields, discards records without a city or any price, authenticates with either header style, and separates timeout from provider error from unsupported response.

Browser voice session integration that discovers availability from a server held public configuration, asks for the microphone before starting, follows call lifecycle events, tears down on unmount, and offers a callback form as the degraded path.

Transactional email integration with deterministic idempotency keys, a verified sender fallback, escaped bodies, and reply semantics that distinguish a stored submission from a delivered notification.
Streaming conversation endpoints that bound and validate the message array before converting it for the model, forward the caller disconnect to the model call, and return an incremental response.

The brand film is served through a range forwarding proxy over blob storage that maps origin statuses onto its own, bounds upstream latency and differs its cache directives by visibility and completeness.
The plain page server optionally mirrors each submission into a hosted database over a graph query interface and forwards received hook events to an external customer system, both best effort.
A lead schema interface change adding optional detail columns, shipped as an idempotent statement with instructions and paired with application tolerance for running before it is applied.

material.material_summary: This repository holds a marketing and sales site for luxury property and collector cars, with validated lead intake, a one off paid access purchase, a multilingual conversational assistant and owner only reporting. Its substance sits in a few small, carefully reasoned modules: exact integer cent arithmetic, request defence primitives, payment confirmation and a dependency free server for a parallel plain page build of the same product. Most remaining files are generated scaffolding, archived copies and configuration.
material.what_i_could_not_assess: Several files the plain page site and its server depend on, including its storage layer, stylesheet, scripts and translation dictionaries, are referenced but absent from the tree.
